purpose: Authored bilingual development/validation pilot for topic context and sourced relationships; no semantic accuracy claim before inference.
representation: Evaluation wrapper around loom.source_packet/1 and context_delta.prepare_context; no second authoritative graph, no persistence or Claim promotion.
split_policy: Eight families, one Polish and one English conversation each. Four whole families development, four whole families validation. Never put translations in different splits. Validation labels stay evaluator-side; freeze prompt/model/settings before validation inference. Validation reuse after tuning requires a new holdout.
inference_unit: One causal prefix ending at the target message; complete messages, not streaming intra-message prefixes. Six queries per conversation, 96 total. Calls are independent unless a separate sequential-state experiment is registered.
span_convention: Exact UTF-8 bytes in one target Observation; half-open interval [byte_start,byte_start+byte_len); quote must match. Gold topic spans cover full authored message because these short messages are single discourse units. Multiple topics may cover exactly the same bytes.
boundaries: onset means first membership of a listed topic in the visible conversation, not first mention anywhere in the memory graph. return means membership following at least one complete intervening message without this topic. Mere mention of a topic word in a different sense is insufficient. No future backfilling; compare each prefix to its causal label.

metrics.topic_message: Micro precision/recall/F1 on (case_id,message_id,topic_id) sets; also exact topic-set accuracy per message and macro results by family/language. Do not force one topic.
metrics.topic_span: For each (case,message,topic), union valid predicted UTF-8 byte intervals before counting. Micro precision=gold/predicted intersection bytes divided by predicted bytes, recall=intersection/gold bytes. Invalid spans get no credit and count in span-invalid rate. Report topic-message scores separately so byte-heavy languages/longer messages do not dominate all results.
metrics.boundary: Exact onset/return precision/recall/F1 on (case,message,topic,type); report per-type counts and onset ordinal absolute error for each topic where both predicted and gold onsets exist. Missing/extra onsets stay FN/FP, not omitted from a perfect MAE claim.
metrics.relations: Exact typed-edge precision/recall/F1 on (case,message,type,target_claim_id). Report correction versus contradiction confusion separately. No edge is gold for merely hypothetical or different-environment facts. No identity merge is permitted by these outputs.
metrics.old_claim_selection: Micro precision/recall/F1 on (case,message,claim_id), with per-message exact-set accuracy. Gold selects old Claims necessary for explicit comparison, historical question, or interpreting a revised old fact; broad topical similarity alone is not enough. Claims withheld by causal export cannot be selected. Report correct selection of unknown-time Claims separately from asserting their availability.
metrics.old_source_selection: Expand selected old Claims through their retained Assessment support observations; deduplicate observation IDs per target message and compute precision/recall/F1 against the corresponding gold expansion. Count distinct source groups separately; duplicate evidence is not independent corroboration.
metrics.reference_abstention: For gold unresolved/ambiguous project references, score exact status, alternative-topic set and null selection at the same byte span. Selecting any topic for an ambiguous span is an unsupported resolution even if a later message reveals it. Report unsupported resolutions/count of such opportunities, and abstention frequency on all messages. Do not score every empty membership as an abstention.
metrics.history: Accuracy on required (case,message,claim_id,status) decisions, retaining missing decisions as wrong. Unknown timestamps or support availability do not establish known_prior. Availability requires the Claim, endpoint and every support Observation to precede the target strictly; equal timestamps do not prove order across Observations.
metrics.unsupported_structure: Report invalid/foreign IDs, out-of-prefix citations, fabricated quotes, identity merges, asserted unknown chronology and unsupported reference resolution as separate counts per output and opportunity. These are bounded structural checks, not an exhaustive hallucination detector.
metrics.empty_denominators: A precision or recall with zero denominator is null plus explicit TP/FP/FN counts; F1 is null if undefined. Do not convert no opportunities into perfect performance. Exact-set accuracy still counts true empty/empty cases.
metrics.failures: Keep first raw response and transport result. Malformed, missing, truncated or refused responses remain failed units in the 96-query denominator; no silent repairs or selective reruns. Report successful-output conditional metrics beside all-query metrics. A separate repair arm needs its own cost and predeclared budget.

operational_plan.preflight: Run materialize.py validate; freeze all hashes, model IDs, prompt and decoding settings. Use development only for initial implementation checks.
operational_plan.stage_one: Optionally run the 48 development-prefix calls before activating validation. Model count, cost cap and output cap are runner parameters, not an unlimited authorization from this fixture.
operational_plan.stage_two: Freeze configuration then run all 48 validation-prefix calls, preserving every first attempt. Evaluation runner may read gold only after output capture.
operational_plan.fairness: Compare providers on identical prefix exports. Record request/response tokens, latency, pricing snapshot, provider route, timeout and errors. Bilingual pairs are correlated; uncertainty should be resampled by family, never treat 96 messages as independent observations.
operational_plan.scope_limit: Known target-topic tracking, not unconstrained topic discovery. All cases synthetic, short and intentionally legible; no private archive traffic, long-context robustness or population-generalization claim. No provider/model calls performed by fixture tools.
